  *(Won 3 stages and consistently placed high in intermediate sprints)*
- **Mountains Classification**: Thomas Sprengers (BEL) / Sport Vlaanderen-Baloise
- **Young Rider Classification**: Stan Dewulf (BEL) / Lotto-Soudal
- **Team Classification**: Wanty-Groupe Gobert

- **Weather & Racing Conditions**: Typically warm late-July conditions with no major weather disruptions. Racing was aggressive, with breakaways featuring heavily on stages 2 and 4.
